efile.text: You must file the wage data and pay the tax electronically if you are an employer who employed 10 or more employees in any quarter during the preceding state fiscal year (July 1 - June 30). There is no waiver from electronic payment.

returns.name: Employer's Quarterly Report (Form RT-6)
contents: Due by April 30, July 31, October 31 and January 31 (late if not postmarked by the last day of the month); when that day is a Saturday, Sunday or legal holiday the timely period extends to the end of the next working day.
Required even if there were no employees or wages in the quarter.

Shows each employee's name, Social Security number, and wages (the first $7,000 of each employee's calendar-year wages are taxable); employers of 10 or more employees in any quarter of the previous state fiscal year file the wage data and pay electronically; the penalty for not filing electronically is $25 per report plus $1 per employee up to $300, and $25 per remittance for not paying electronically.
